sources.entry: Genealogy software used to record, organize, and publish genealogical data.

summary.name: Genealogy software
summary.one_liner: Wikipedia overview of genealogy software, a category of programs for recording, organizing, and publishing family history data.
use_cases: recording births, marriages and deaths of ancestors
producing pedigree charts and text reports
sharing family data with other genealogy programs via GEDCOM
publishing a family tree as HTML pages
creating genograms for social or medical analysis
managing sources and citations for genealogy research
summary.what_it_does: The page describes genealogy software as programs used to record, organize, and publish genealogical data. At minimum such programs store birth, marriage, and death dates and places, plus parent, spouse, and child relationships, and most also handle life events, notes, multimedia, and source citations. They can produce graphical charts and text reports such as pedigree charts, ahnentafel, and Register reports, and some generate HTML pages for web publishing. Most support GEDCOM import and export, and some programs can restrict sharing of living people's data for privacy.
notable: Most programs import and export the GEDCOM standard
Can produce pedigree charts, ahnentafel and Register reports
Some programs create genograms for non-genealogy uses
Privacy controls can hide living people's data on export
caveats: The article notes it needs more citations
Describes the category generally; does not name or compare specific products
